text: Install a skill directly from a GitHub repo with a single CLI command
quote: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills

text: Generate a skill's agent-ready prompt and print it to stdout so it can be piped straight into an agent without a persistent install
quote: `skills use` resolves sources the same way as `skills add`, writes the selected skill files to a temporary directory, and prints only the generated prompt to stdout

text: Install only specific named skills from a collection, or use '*' to install all of them
quote: Install specific skills by name (use `'*'` for all skills)

text: Target specific coding agents (e.g. claude-code, codex) when installing a skill
quote: Target specific agents (e.g., `claude-code`, `codex`)

text: List the skills available in a repository without installing anything
quote: List available skills without installing

text: Install skills to a user/global directory instead of the project directory
quote: Install to user directory instead of project

text: Run installation non-interactively, suitable for CI/CD pipelines
quote: Non-interactive installation (CI/CD friendly)

text: Add skills from public or private repos using the same command, relying on existing configured repo auth
quote: Use the same command for public and private repositories. The CLI uses the authentication already configured for the repository URL

text: List all currently installed skills, similar to `npm ls`
quote: List all installed skills. Similar to `npm ls`.

text: Search for skills interactively or by keyword
quote: Search for skills interactively or by keyword

text: Search across every repository owned by a given organization or user
quote: Search across every repository owned by an organization or user

text: Update installed skills to their latest versions, individually or all at once
quote: Update installed skills to latest versions

text: Remove installed skills from one or more agents
quote: Remove installed skills from agents

text: Scaffold a new SKILL.md template with `skills init`
quote: Create a new SKILL.md template

text: Build a skill once and reuse it across any skills-compatible agent
quote: Cross-product reuse: Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent.

text: Installs skills as symlinks from each agent to one canonical copy, giving a single source of truth for easy updates
quote: Creates symlinks from each agent to a canonical copy. Single source of truth, easy updates.

text: Add a skill from a full GitHub URL, not just owner/repo shorthand
quote:
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills

# Full GitHub URL
npx skills add https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills

text: Add a skill directly from a downloadable SKILL.md or archive URL
quote: npx skills add https://example.com/download/my-skill

text: Add a skill from a GitLab-hosted repository URL
quote:
# GitLab URL
npx skills add https://gitlab.com/org/repo

text: Add a skill from an Azure Repos (Azure DevOps) URL
quote:
# GitLab URL
npx skills add https://gitlab.com/org/repo

# Azure Repos (Azure DevOps Services or Server)
npx skills add https://dev.azure.com/org/project/_git/repo

text: Default project-scope install writes skill files that are committed with the project and shared with the team
quote: **Project** | (default) | `./<agent>/skills/` | Committed with your project, shared with team

text: Officially supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and dozens of other agents
quote: Supports **OpenCode**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Cursor**, and [75 more](#supported-agents).

text: Restore a previously installed skill set from a skills-lock.json lockfile
quote: `skills experimental_install` | Restore skills from skills-lock.json

text: At agent startup, only each skill's name and description are loaded so the agent can judge relevance before activating it
quote: At startup, agents load only the name and description of each available skill, just enough to know when it might be relevant.

text: Validate a skill folder's structure/spec compliance with `skills-ref validate`
quote: skills-ref validate ./my-skill

text: Sync installed skills from node_modules into each agent's directory
quote: skills experimental_sync    | Sync skills from node_modules into agent dirs

text: Skills can bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other supporting resources beyond the SKILL.md file
quote: Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.

text: SKILL.md frontmatter can declare an allowed-tools list restricting which tools a skill may use
quote: | `allowed-tools` | No       | Space-separated string of pre-approved tools the skill may use. (Experimental)

text: A valid SKILL.md must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content
quote: The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.

text: A public Skills Leaderboard lets users browse available skills
quote: Skills Leaderboard
